name: Maple Glaze
desc: A ribbon of hot cider sets into candy-glass. Light damage; the foe is Sticky.

ranks.desc: A ribbon of hot cider sets into candy-glass. Light damage; the foe is Sticky for longer.

name: Arcane Bolt
desc: A lance of starlight strikes one foe.

name: Rime Touch
desc: Frost damage; the foe is Chilled and acts last next round.

ranks.desc: Frost damage; the foe is Chilled and acts last for two rounds.

name: Arcane Channel
desc: Restore 10 MP, and take less harm while gathering it. The next skill is empowered.

ranks.desc: Restore 15 MP, and take less harm while gathering it. The next skill is empowered.

name: Earthen Invocation
desc: Stone spikes under every foe. Also lifts fallen wall stones.

name: Hearthlight
desc: Heal about a third of someone's health and shake off the chill.

ranks.desc: Heal 36% of someone's health and shake off the chill.
Heal over two fifths of someone's health and shake off the chill.

name: Hoarfrost
desc: Frost races across the ground. Light damage; every foe is Chilled.

name: Icicle Lance
desc: A heavy spear of ice. Lands critical hits far more often on a Chilled foe.

name: Starfall
desc: Three falling stars strike foes at random.

ranks.desc: Four falling stars strike foes at random.

name: Frost Heave
desc: Frozen ground bursts upward under one foe. A Chilled foe is flung clear and loses its next turn.

name: Rime Coat
desc: Frost hardens over someone: blows spend the coat first, and whoever strikes it is Chilled.

name: Mulled Warmth
desc: Spiced steam wraps someone: they heal a little each turn for 3 turns and can't be Chilled.

ranks.desc: Spiced steam wraps someone: they heal a little each turn for 4 turns and can't be Chilled.

name: Leyline Sigil
desc: Marks a foe for 3 turns: its weaknesses show, and every hero hits it harder.

ranks.desc: Marks a foe for 4 turns: its weaknesses show, and every hero hits it harder.

name: Wall of Rime
desc: Frost climbs into a low wall before the whole party: a shield worth 15% of each one's health for a round, and whoever breaks through it is Chilled.

ranks.desc: Frost climbs into a low wall before the whole party: a shield worth 18% of each one's health for a round, and whoever breaks through it is Chilled.
Frost climbs into a low wall before the whole party: a shield worth 22% of each one's health for a round, and whoever breaks through it is Chilled.

name: Thaw
desc: Hearth damage on one foe. Once learned, any hearth hit on a Chilled foe, Maple Glaze too, bursts into steam: half the blow scalds every other foe.

name: Black Ice
desc: The ground under every foe glazes black. Frost damage, much heavier on a Chilled foe, and the Chill holds.

name: Banked Fire
desc: Embers banked under everyone's feet: the whole party heals a little each turn for 4 turns.

ranks.desc: Embers banked under everyone's feet: the whole party heals a little each turn for 5 turns.

name: Hard Frost
desc: A deep frost falls on the field. Frost damage to every foe, and every Chilled foe freezes in place and loses its next turn.

name: Deep Cold
desc: The cold goes into the ground and stays. Light frost on every foe; for 4 rounds they grow slower each round, and each round they are Chilled afresh.

name: Avalanche
desc: The hillside lets go. Heavy earth on every foe, and a Chilled foe shatters for half again as much.

name: Hoar on the Blades
desc: Frost feathers along every staff, crook and beak. Each friend's next two spells or moves land 40% harder (a plain attack doesn't use it up).

name: Cold Moon
desc: The December moon rises white over the field. Five shafts of moonlight fall on foes at random, each much heavier on a Chilled foe, and the Chill holds.

name: Frost Ward
desc: Cut damage by 60% until his next turn, and gather 4 MP. Attackers are Chilled.

ranks.desc: Cut damage by two thirds until his next turn, and gather 4 MP. Attackers are Chilled.
Cut damage by 70% until his next turn, and gather 4 MP. Attackers are Chilled for longer.
Cut damage by three quarters until his next turn, and gather 4 MP. Attackers are Chilled for longer.

name: Stone Ward
desc: Cut damage by three quarters until his next turn, and gather 4 MP.

name: Hearth Ward
desc: Cut damage by 60%, and gather 4 MP. At the start of his next turn he heals a little and shakes off Sticky and chill.

name: Glacial Bloom
desc: Ward move. Frost blossoms, then shatters every foe. Ready when the Ward gauge is full.

name: Footing Stone
desc: "Come on, then. I'm the one standing here." A stone blow, and foes aim at him until his next turn.

name: Fill Grit
desc: Small stuff first. Always the small stuff first. Light damage; the foe is Sticky.

name: Thayer Wall
desc: Four generations of fieldstone rise, crooked and gapped, each laid by a Thayer hand. Holds 3 blows or 3 rounds; once a fight.

ranks.desc: Four generations of fieldstone rise, crooked and gapped, each laid by a Thayer hand. Holds 4 blows or 4 rounds; once a fight.

name: Catch Breath
desc: Sixty-one winters. A man's allowed a breather. Gets 10 stamina back, and his next move is stronger.

name: Capstone
desc: "Somebody's half-done job. I'll finish it proper." Much harder on a Chilled foe, and ends the Chill.

name: Tumbled Course
desc: Never a straight line. Not even coming down. Stone falls on every foe.

name: Let It Settle
desc: "Everything settles, given a knock." A plain blow; the foe is Chilled and acts last next round.

name: Pin and Wedge
desc: One to set it, one to keep it set. Hits one foe twice.

name: Step In
desc: "Behind me. Mind your feet." Takes the blows aimed at one friend until his next turn.

name: Long Sledge
desc: Four generations swung it. Heavier every one. A huge plain blow.

name: Frost Crack
desc: "Cold gets in the joints. Always has." A crack runs through every foe; all are Chilled.

name: Through-Stone
desc: Set square across the gap, like a through-stone holding both faces. A shield on one friend.

name: Crooked Course
desc: "Never a straight line. Let's see it follow that." Stone across every foe, and all are Muddled for a round: blows aimed at one hero may land on another foe.

name: Hearting
desc: "The small stones in the middle. Nobody sees them. They're what holds it." He shakes off whatever is wrong with him, and his next two moves are stronger.

name: Coping Stones
desc: "Last on, and heaviest. That's what keeps the rest down." The top course comes down on every foe, heavy, and harder on a Sticky one.

name: Batter
desc: "Lean it in at the top. It'll stand a hundred years." A shield on everyone, worth 15% of their health, for 2 rounds.

ranks.desc: "Lean it in at the top. It'll stand a hundred years." A shield on everyone, worth 18% of their health, for 2 rounds.
"Lean it in at the top. It'll stand a hundred years." A shield on everyone, worth 22% of their health, for 2 rounds.

name: Four Generations
desc: "Great-grandfather. Grandfather. Father. Me." Four great blows of the old sledge, each on a foe at random.

name: Spit on the Last Stone
desc: "Luck. That's all it is. My father did it." He spits on the last stone and sets it. He shakes off whatever's wrong with him, nothing harmful can land on him for 2 rounds, and foes aim at him until his next turn.

name: Cheek End
desc: "End it square, or the whole run unravels." A heavy stone blow on one foe, and its guard is Cracked: every hero's blows on it land harder for 2 rounds.

name: Bield
desc: "Sheep know. Get in the lee of the wall and wait it out." A bield is the old shelter wall for sheep in snow. A shield on the whole party worth a fifth of their health for 3 rounds, and while it holds nobody can be Chilled or Slowed.

name: Stone Boat
desc: "Every stone in every wall came out of somebody's field." He drags the stone sled across the field: heavy stone on every foe, all Slowed, and with his Frozen Course every Chilled foe loses its turn.

name: No Mortar
desc: Mortar cracks. Dry stone just settles. Cut damage by 70% until his next turn.

name: Hand's Gap
desc: A stone set just so, which he can't explain and which shouldn't work. Everyone gets a shield worth a quarter of their health. Ready when the Ward gauge is full.

name: Honk
desc: One flat, enormous blare. A light blow on every foe, and all are Slowed: they act last next round.

name: Nip Awake
desc: A nip to the back of the leg. They lose a little health, shake off Drowsy, Blinded, Frightened and Muddled, and their next move hits harder.

name: Won't Let Go
desc: A peck. On the same foe turn after turn it hits harder each time, up to two and a half times the first. From the second in a row armor and curling up don't help, from the third it Hexes, and the fourth Cracks its guard so everyone hits it harder. Anything else, or another foe, starts it over.

name: Bites Back
desc: She settles low and watches. Until her next turn, the first foe to strike anyone in the party is bitten: pulled out of its shell, paid back part of its own blow past any armor, and Hexed.

name: Hold a Grudge
desc: She fixes one foe with a look it won't forget. For 3 rounds, any blow it lands on a hero Hexes it, however small.

ranks.desc: She fixes one foe with a look it won't forget. For 5 rounds, any blow it lands on a hero Hexes it, however small.

name: Pass It On
desc: Whatever's wrong with one foe, the rest catch: its hexes spread to every other foe.

name: Bad Luck
desc: Every Hexed foe is Muddled for 2 rounds: its blows aimed at one target may land on another foe.

ranks.desc: Every Hexed foe is Muddled for 3 rounds: its blows aimed at one target may land on another foe.

name: Under My Wing
desc: One friend goes under her wing: until her next turn, nothing can hurt them.

name: Last Straw
desc: One hard peck that finds the soft spots, much harder for every hex on the foe, and the hexes are spent.

name: Fuss
desc: She fusses round everyone: they shake off Frightened and Drowsy, and their next move hits harder.

name: Hiss
desc: Head down, neck out, a hiss like a kettle. Every foe is Frightened for 2 rounds: it may cower instead of acting, and one badly hurt runs off.

ranks.desc: Head down, neck out, a hiss like a kettle. Every foe is Frightened for 3 rounds: it may cower instead of acting, and one badly hurt runs off.

name: Evil Eye
desc: She looks at each of them in turn. Every foe is Hexed.

name: Feathers Fly
desc: Wings, beak and feet: four pecks on foes at random, each finding the soft spots: resisting and curling up don't help.

name: Not While I'm Watching
desc: The party shakes off everything harmful, and nothing new can land on them for 2 rounds.

ranks.desc: The party shakes off everything harmful, and nothing new can land on them for 3 rounds.

name: Calls the Flock
desc: She honks once, and every goose for a mile answers. Six pecks land on foes at random, each one Hexing.

name: Dust Up
desc: Wings out and beating, dust and down everywhere. Every foe is Blinded for 2 rounds: blows it aims at one hero often miss.

name: Goes for the Eyes
desc: One peck, well aimed. It finds the soft spots, and the foe is Blinded and Cracked for 2 rounds.

name: Long Memory
desc: She looks at every one of them and remembers. For 3 rounds, any foe that lands a blow on a hero is Hexed for it.

name: The Last Word
desc: She has the last word with every foe: a peck each that finds the soft spots, much harder for every hex on it, and the hexes are spent.

name: Preen
desc: She tidies herself. Blows land 40% softer until her next turn, which matters once she can be hurt, and when it comes she shakes off whatever was wrong with her.

name: Fair Swap
desc: Her share of health and one friend's trade places: she at full and they nearly down becomes the other way round. Ready when the Ward gauge is full.

name: Old Country Air
desc: "This one's older than the town." A light hit, and the friend who hits hardest has their next move stronger.

name: The Nonsense Verse
desc: "Nobody knows what it means. Hum along anyway." A light hit, and the foe is Muddled for 2 rounds: its blows aimed at one hero may land on another foe.

name: Kitchen Reel
desc: "Fast enough to warm the room." A hearth hit on one foe.

name: Played for the Governor
desc: "I'll have you know I sang for the Governor!" Foes aim at him until his next turn, and his next move hits half again as hard. Not a song: it breaks the tune.

name: The Cold Wind Blows
desc: "Wrap up. It's that kind of song." A frost hit; the foe is Chilled and acts last next round.

name: The Lantern Man
desc: "Mind the lantern man. He keeps the count." The foe is Marked: everyone's hits on it land a quarter harder for 3 rounds.

ranks.desc: "Mind the lantern man. He keeps the count." The foe is Marked: everyone's hits on it land harder for 4 rounds.

name: Harvest Reel
desc: "On your feet! It's a fair, isn't it?" Every foe is Slowed: they act last next round, so the party goes first.

ranks.desc: "On your feet! It's a fair, isn't it?" Every foe is Slowed for 2 rounds: they act last, so the party goes first.

name: The Great Fire
desc: "Everyone knows how this one ends." Finale: spends every Verse. Fire on every foe, stronger for each Verse spent.

name: Thunder on the Hills
desc: "Hear that? That's the chorus." A light storm hit on every foe; all are Shocked, so the next hurt each takes lands harder.

name: Drinking Song
desc: "One more verse. Then home. Probably." The party heals a little and shakes off Drowsy and Frightened.

name: The Long Winter
desc: "It went on, that winter. It went on." Finale: spends every Verse. One foe, very hard for each Verse spent, and it's Chilled.

name: Gather Round
desc: "All of you. Closer. You'll want to hear this." Finale: spends every Verse. Every friend's next move is stronger, and they're shielded a little, more for each Verse spent.

name: The Freshet
desc: "Spring comes down the river all at once." A tide hit; the foe is knocked back and acts last next round.

name: The Verse That Makes No Sense
desc: "Every old song has a verse that makes no sense. I always thought it was the best part." It strikes with whichever element this foe is weak to; if it has none, arcane.

name: Every Verse at Once
desc: "All of it. The silly bits too." Finale: spends every Verse. One hit for each Verse spent, each on a foe at random and each in a different element, so every foe meets its weakness sooner or later.

name: Old Hundredth
desc: "Everyone knows this one. Sing up." Finale: spends every Verse. The party heals for each Verse spent and shakes off everything harmful.

name: The Whole Song
desc: "Start to finish. No skipping." Finale: spends every Verse. Every foe, very hard for each Verse spent; anyone Marked, Shocked or Muddled takes it twice.

name: Tune Up
desc: "Hold on. She's gone flat." Blows land half as hard until his next turn, and the tune doesn't break.

name: The Lullaby
desc: "Hush now. That's the one she liked." Every foe is Drowsy for 3 rounds: they nod off and lose turns, until something hits them. Ready when the Ward gauge is full.

name: The Whole Room
desc: "Everybody, now. You know this one." Finale: needs a full tune, and spends it. For a round, every song he sings reaches the whole party, or every foe. Taught at the singing school; the fuller the room was, the longer it lasts.

ranks.desc: "Everybody, now. You know this one." Finale: needs a full tune, and spends it. For two rounds, every song he sings reaches the whole party, or every foe.
"Everybody, now. You know this one." Finale: needs a full tune, and spends it. For three rounds, every song he sings reaches the whole party, or every foe.

name: The Quickstep
desc: "Keep up, keep up. It only gets faster." A light hit on one foe. If he moves before every foe this round, he goes again at once (once a round).

name: The Devil's Reel
desc: "Once it starts, you dance till the fiddler stops. And I don't stop." Finale: spends every Verse. One foe dances and loses its next turn, and another for every two Verse spent: three at a full tune. A boss loses one turn at most, and can't be made to dance again for a while.

ranks.desc: "Once it starts, you dance till the fiddler stops. And I don't stop." Finale: spends every Verse. One foe dances and loses its next turn, and another for every two Verse spent, rounded up: four at a full tune, two from a single Verse. A boss loses one turn at most, and can't be made to dance again for a while.

name: Finnegan's Wake
desc: "A drop of whiskey on him and up he gets. Works in the song, anyway." Finale: spends every Verse. A friend who's down gets back up, with more health for each Verse spent. On a friend still standing, it heals instead.

name: Once More, From the Top
desc: "They're shouting for it. Who am I to argue?" Finale: needs a full tune, and spends it. He plays the last finale he played this fight again, at the Verse it had, on whoever he picks.

ranks.desc: "They're shouting for it. Who am I to argue?" Finale: needs a full tune, and spends it. He plays the last finale he played this fight again, with one Verse more than it had, on whoever he picks.
"They're shouting for it. Who am I to argue?" Finale: needs a full tune, and spends it. He plays the last finale he played this fight again, with two Verse more than it had, on whoever he picks.

"They're shouting for it. Who am I to argue?" Finale: needs a full tune, and spends it. He plays any finale he knows, at the Verse it had last time (a full tune if it hasn't been played yet) and two Verse more, on whoever he picks.
